Commentary.Commentary: Okay - on that note from the big man, experience certainly made its presence felt. West Indies have thumped the Proteas in the start of a bumper home season. Watch out, South Africa. Also be prepared, Australia. And all the best, Pakistan. As far as the T20 World Cup is concerned, it is certainly looking at someone who can challenge these blokes. But let's not go that far. The second T20I is almost upon us, with less than 24 hours to go. Join us then again, on Sunday, 27th June, 2021 at 2 pm local (1800 GMT). You can catch how the white-ball leg of the multi-format Indian Women's tour of England goes about in Bristol. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious West Indies captain, Kieron Pollard, says that they got in a pretty good start. Credits his bowlers for executing the laid-out plans well. Is happy with the positive attitude shown by his batsmen. Calls Evin Lewis a very talented guy and details that he has been doing it for the last couple of years, so it is not actually a big surprise to see him perform well. Ends by saying that compared to the Test side, the white-ball unit is more experienced.

South African skipper, Temba Bavuma, starts by saying that they are disappointed. Stresses that they didn't want to start this way but assures that the Proteas will come back stronger on Sunday, with greater execution. Adds that it was a decent score but they were relying very heavily on bowlers. Admits that they didn't capitalise on their batting in the second half. Honestly says that they were expecting the Windies to come hard at them with the bat, stressing the Lewis-Fletcher stand. Ends by saying that the Saffas have to be more tactically sound and come back stronger in the next game.

EVIN LEWIS HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Lewis says that he is always backing his ability. Adds that it was a nice pitch to bat and that he is a very confident guy, Further says, if the ball is in his arc, he'll have a go but if not, then he will be happy with the single. On possible thoughts of a century, Lewis says that he was indeed thinking about it. Ends by saying that the team should capitalize on this win and carry on.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

Earlier, after electing to bowl, West Indies produced a reasonable bowling display, with Fabian Allen choking the Proteas. For all the big hitting that the Windies are known about, very rarely do they get praised for their bowling skills. They do not have world-class bowlers but they certainly have smart cricketers who know their job well. Please stay tuned for the presentation.
The South African bowling attack wears a forlorn look. Only Tabraiz Shamsi bore respectable figures while Anrich Nortje escaped with just the 2 overs. The rest, just got a tour around the park.

South Africa never even got a chance to understand what was happening. Evin Lewis started his innings with a six and kept dealing in boundaries throughout. His 35-ball 71 had 11 hits to the fence, 7 of them crossing the ropes on the full. 58 of his 71 came in boundaries, with the remaining 13 taking him 23 balls! Andre Fletcher and Chris Gayle played their part while Andre Russell came and finished it off. But really, it was Lewis who was running the show.

Wow. Done and dusted with 5 overs to spare. Would even 200 have made any difference? Don't think so. And the likes of Pollard and Holder did not even come out to bat. Fearsome. Really fearsome batting line up.
SIX! West Indies win by 8 wickets. A length ball, outside off. Andre Russell gets low and drags it over mid-wicket for a six.
SWING AND A MISS! A back of a length ball, outside off. Russell slashes but misses.
Another short ball, on off. Gayle half-pulls it to mid-wicket for a single. Just 6 to win for West Indies.
Short ball, on middle. Andre Russell pulls it on the toes towards square leg for a single.
SIX! Smashed! Full ball, on middle. Andre Russell gets low and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie. That's gone on the second tier.
Eased down to mid-wicket for a single.
Change. Lungi Ngidi is back into the action.
FOUR! Whacked! Tosses it up, on middle. Russell goes on knee and slogs it between mid-wicket and square leg for a boundary.
Outside off. Punched off the back foot to covers.
Goes for the pull again, but mistimes it in the vacant square region for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Driven to mid on.
FOUR! 20 runs more to win! Goes fuller, on off. Gayle heaves it over the bowler's head towards long on for a boundary.
WIDE! Goes over the wicket and spills this over the tramline outside off.
SIX! Smoked! Short ball, on middle. Gayle rocks back and whacks it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
George Linde is back into the action.
Good comeback by Kagiso Rabada after getting hit for the six! Short ball, outside off. Russ misses his pull.
4 dots on the trot! Good comeback from Rabada. Another slower short ball, outside off. Russ misses his pull.
3 dots on the trot! Another short ball, slower, outside off. Andre Russell misses his pull.
Again same line, same length. Andre Russell misses his pull.
Another short ball, outside off. Russell looks to pull but misses.
SIX! What a way to get underway! That's out of the ground! Short ball, on middle. Andre Russell whacks it over square leg for a biggie.
On middle. Blocked out.
Andre Russell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Evin Lewis departs for a well-made 71 of just 35 balls! Might have done his job! A loopy ball, on middle. Evin Lewis looks to go downtown but gets the toe end of the bat. The ball lobs in the air towards long off where David Miller runs back and takes a wonderful catch. Both set batsmen gone. Do South Africa have a glimmer of hope? West Indies need 37 from 49 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Cut down to sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! Shamsi spills it down the leg side. Gale looks to paddle it but misses.
On middle. Lewis paddles it to square leg for one.
SIX! Banged! Floated ball, on middle. Lewis gets on knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

CHANCE! A loopy ball, outside off. Gayle cuts it to point and runs across. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end and appeals for the run out. It is referred upstairs but replays show that de Kock dislodged the bails before the throw came! Costly, costly miss.
In the air but safe! Another loopy ball, outside off. Lewis looks to go over the covers but doesn't middle it. The ball rolls over in the air and in the vacant cover region. Two taken.
SIX! Dispatched! 19 already off this over! Floated on middle. Lewis stands tall and lofts it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Tossed up, outside off. Lewis cuts it to the point fielder.
Outside off. Dabbed to point for one.
SIX! Back-to-back sixes! Short ball, around middle and leg. Gayle stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Change. Reeza Hendricks is into the action.
SIX! The Universe Boss has arrived! Floated on middle. Gayle lofts it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Fuller ball, on off. Tapped to point.
Flatter, on off. Pushed to covers.
Fractionally short, on middle. Lewis punches it off the back foot to covers for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Gayle pushes it to covers and takes a single.
BEATEN! Googly, on middle. Gayle lunges forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On middle. Pushed to covers.
Length ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Fuller and on the pads. Gayle flicks it to square leg for a single.
On a length ball, outside off. Gayle taps it to point.
Length ball, outside off. Gayle leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
Full ball, on middle. Driven to mid on for a single.
Fuller, outside off. This is driven to covers.
Change. Anrich Nortje is back.
Landed outside off, Gayle err... lets it go!
Short, outside off, cut through point for one more.
Fuller, around middle, Chris Gayle pushes it towards long off for a single to get off the mark.
This is around middle, nudged to the leg side.
Floated, around off, defended watchfully.
Outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Who comes in now? Universe Boss? You bet. Chris Gayle is in the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT OFF A WIDE! The Proteas finally break the opening partnership of 86. And good awareness by Ngidi as well! This is bowled on the pads, Fletcher makes room and looks to sweep but misses. The ball spins away and rolls to Lungi Ngidi at short fine leg. Now, Fletcher is looking at the ball and by that time, Lewis has aready called him through for the run. Fletcher starts to run now, but by then, Ngidi has fired a throw at the bowler's end. It hits the stumps and the run out appeal is referred upstairs. Replays show that Fletcher's bat is short! Perhaps a bit late, but a breakthrough nevertheless. West Indies need 75 more from 78 balls.
Around off, pushed to the bowler.
SIX! What a way to bring up your 50 and that too in just 22 balls! A fuller ball, on middle. Evin Lewis lofts it straight down the ground for a biggie. Will want to see his side home now.

Overthrows! Fuller, on off. Lewis squeezes it out to mid-wicket. Now, Andre Fletcher wants the second, but is sent back. The fielder, Temba Bavuma comes charging in and fires a throw to the keeper, Quinton de Kock. However, de Kock fails to collect and the ball hits the stumps. That causes a deflection to the other side and the batsmen take the second.
Eased down to long on for a single.
Another length ball, outside off. Lewis cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Dabs it to third man for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Andre Fletcher flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single. End of the Powerplay, West Indies are 73-0.
Lungi Ngidi will start the post-Powerplay session. The first 6 overs were full of brute power. 1-0-20-0 for Ngidi so far.
WIDE! Spills it down the leg side. Andre Fletcher misses his flick. Wide called.
Darted on the pads. This is flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Another loopy ball, outside off. Fletcher lofts it towards the vacant cover region for a boundary
FOUR! Well Played! Loopy ball, outside off. Andre Fletcher drives it through covers for a boundary.
Darted on the pads. This is flicked on the leg side.
Flatter and outside off. Andre Fletcher cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Spin started the Powerplay, spin will end it. Here's Tabraiz Shamsi.
On middle. Defended out on the off side.

Fuller ball, outside off. Lewis smashes it towards the mid on fielder, Temba Bavuma, who sees Fletcher out of his line and has a shy at the bowler's end and hits the stumps. The run out appeal is taken upstairs but replays show that Fletcher had his bat down in time when the bails went off.
Fuller ball, outside off. Andre Fletcher drags it to mid off for a single.
Short ball, on middle. Ducked under.
FOUR! Shot of the day! A fuller length delivery, outside off. Andre Fletcher drives it on one knee, through point for four.

SIX! Hammered! The pounding continues. Short ball, on middle. Fletcher pulls it towards the square leg fence, where Reeza Hendricks leaps for the catch, almost takes it but then falls over the ropes. Would have been an absolute stunner.
Kagiso Rabada is swung around. Went for 15 from the other end in his opener.

SIX! Don't bowl short to Evin Lewis, he will dispatched everything in that arc. Another short delivery, on middle. Lewis smokes it in front of square on the leg side for a six. Big over for West Indies, 20 off it!
SIX! Another short ball, another boundary! Stand-and-deliver stuff from Evin Lewis! A short ball, on off. Lewis stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
SWING AND A MISS! Tad fuller, outside off. Lewis swings his blade but misses to connect it.

Ouch! That must be hurting to Evin Lewis! A pacy length delivery, on middle. Lewis looks to pull but misses. The ball rolls through and hits Lewis on the box. He is in agony and the physio is out for a quick check-up.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! A back of a length ball, on leg. Lewis helps it past short fine leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, says Evin Lewis! A fuller ball, on middle. Lewis drives it uppishly but wide of mid on for a boundary.
Lungi Ngidi is into the action. 4th different bowler in 4 overs.
LEG BYE! Full ball, on leg. 150 kph. Lewis misses his flick. The ball rolls over to the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Full and on middle. Lewis flicks it to mid-wicket.
Another fuller length delivery, outside off. Fletcher chops it wide of short third man for a single.
Fuller and on off. Andre Fletcher taps it to short third man.
SIX! Fletcher joins the party as well! A back of a length ball, on off. Fletcher pulls it over mid-wicket for a six.
Back of a length and on off, Lewis guides it through point for one.
Anrich Nortje is into the action now.
Fuller and on middle. This is driven to mid on for a quick single. 15 off the over.
SIX! Dispatched! Another short ball, on middle. Evin Lewis gets on top of the bounce and pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Length ball, around leg. Lewis tickles it past short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Fearless!  A length ball, outside off. Picks up the length quickly, gets into position and pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
A good length ball, on middle. Lewis blocks it out.
Starts with a quick short ball, on middle. Evin Lewis looks to pull but connects with thin air.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Kagiso Rabada.
Around off, Lewis pushes it through mid off to end the over with a run.
SIX! PUMMELED! There goes Lewis. Boy, he does not even need a sighter. Short, around middle and leg, Evin Lewis rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket! 154 more needed from 115 balls.
Flatter and fuller outside off, Fletcher pushes it to point this time and crosses over for a single. West Indies and the run chase are underway.
Fractionally short, outside off, slapped straight to point.
On middle and leg, Andre Fletcher nudges it to the leg side.
Fuller, around middle, a bit of flight, respectfully pushed back to the bowler.
